songs.title: Ransom
songs.author: Jade Key (ft. Mary Sweet)
songs.lyrics:
You were like a ransom note.
If I given will you come home?
I put everything I had into getting you back.

You were the end I bring.
I walked across the burning bridge for you.

Those words we walked,
I'll know forever.
Those times we talked,
I still remember there is a God enough that I
did with my heart once twice.

I pay

I tried to find a way to justify missing the
sights I knew.
My hands were tied the moment we met,
and there was more to you.

And that was your sixth release.
I was to try to seal the way to you.
Those words we walked,
I'll know forever.
Those times we talked,
I still remember.

Is it not enough that I barely got out with
my life?
Asked to carry everything.
